_comment: Demo content for screenshot mode. Loaded only when the app is launched with -FilScreenshotMode. UUIDs are pinned on purpose: a fil's blob shape is a hash of its uuid, so changing one changes how it looks. Gradients are from Fil's own palette. `daysAgo` is relative to launch so the library always reads as recently used. Edit freely, this is content, not code. `state` controls what isn't stored as content: which folder is pinned to the Lock Screen, and the appearance override. `summary` is the caption in the folder list; `summaryParts` are the handwritten stamps on the pinned hero, and a folder can have one without the other. No em dashes anywhere in this file: every string here is copy a user reads, and Fil's voice bans them. `audio` and `images` name files bundled in Fil/Resources. Asset provenance: demo-voice.m4a is generated locally with `say`; demo-photo-1.jpg is from Unsplash (unsplash.com/photos/qMf0Qf6p1-g), free for commercial use.
